basedOn.policy: Conservative project profile; it does not claim to be a complete official allowlist.

preview.description: Local preview only; external/local images degrade but do not block.

editor-paste.description: Paste into the editor; unresolved images degrade so they can be repaired before draft creation.

draft.description: Remote draft input; every image URL must be HTTPS and on an explicit host allowlist.

officialCheckerGaps.reason: Upstream reserves text and skipped cases only; it is not in the specification or implemented, so v1 does not invent a verdict.

rules.recommendation: Remove the tag and replace it with article-safe markup.

rules.message: Inline event handlers can execute script
rules.recommendation: Remove every on* attribute; interactivity must not rely on JavaScript.

rules.message: Attribute enables embedded or form-controlled content

rules.recommendation: Use an HTTPS URL, an anchor, or a project-managed relative link as appropriate.

rules.message: Link scheme may be stripped or behave inconsistently
rules.recommendation: Prefer an explicit HTTPS link or a plain-text citation.

rules.message: Absolute, fixed, or sticky positioning is disabled by this profile
rules.recommendation: Reflow the component with normal document flow and spacing.

rules.message: Grid layout or floated content is disabled by this profile
rules.recommendation: Use normal flow, inline-block, flex, or a table where appropriate.

rules.message: Animation, transition, or smooth-scroll motion is disabled by this profile
rules.recommendation: Remove motion declarations and provide a stable static presentation.

rules.message: CSS custom properties or var() are disabled by this profile
rules.recommendation: Compile tokens to literal CSS values before delivery.
Remove expression(), behavior, -moz-binding, and at-rule constructs from inline styles.

rules.message: Modern CSS color function may not survive every WeChat WebView
rules.recommendation: Compile to rgb()/rgba() and verify light/dark mode rendering.

rules.message: Custom font-family is discouraged by specification chapter 3
rules.recommendation: Remove font-family and inherit the official default font stack.
Keep only text and inline elements such as span, strong, em, a, code, br, and img inside span[leaf].

rules.message: section[nodeleaf] contains content outside the explicit component allowlist
rules.recommendation: By default keep only img children; other official components must be explicitly configured after verification.

rules.message: Image data-w must be its intrinsic width as a finite positive number
rules.recommendation: Set data-w to the source image pixel width, for example data-w=1080.

rules.message: Image has no usable src or data-src
rules.recommendation: Provide a real image URL before delivery.

rules.message: Local, relative, or otherwise non-remote image source
rules.recommendation: Upload the image to WeChat and replace src with the returned HTTPS URL.

rules.message: Image URL is HTTP or protocol-relative instead of explicit HTTPS
rules.recommendation: Use an explicit HTTPS image URL.

rules.message: Image host is not in the delivery allowlist
rules.recommendation: Transfer the image to an allowed WeChat host and replace every src/srcset/CSS url reference.
